What TypeScript static analysis, type-level safety, and compile-time protection mechanisms should an OpenAPI SDK wrapper use? "ts-morph wraps the TypeScript Compiler API to simplify AST setup, navigation, and manipulation, providing helper methods on top of compiler objects while allowing fallback to raw compiler API when needed"

5. Is this a marketing claim / press release / cherry-picked benchmark / forum speculation?
